verses.text: "Write this to the angel of the church in Sardis: This is what the one says who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I know what you do. People say you are alive, but you are dead.
Wake up! Make strong what is left, before it dies too. I have found that what you do is not complete in the eyes of my God.
So remember what you received and heard. Obey it, and turn back to God. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come to you.
But there are a few people in Sardis who have not made their clothes dirty. They will walk with me dressed in white, because they are worthy.
The one who wins the victory will be dressed in white like them. I will never erase his name from the book of life. I will say his name before my Father and his angels.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
Write this to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: This is what the one says who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What he opens, no one can shut, and what he shuts, no one can open.
I know what you do. Look, I have put an open door in front of you that no one can shut. I know you have only a little strength, yet you have kept my word and have not denied my name.
Look, there are some from the synagogue of Satan who say they are Jews but are not. They are lying. I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I have loved you.
You have obeyed my command to keep going patiently. So I will keep you safe from the time of testing that is coming on the whole world, to test the people who live on the earth.
I am coming soon! Hold on to what you have, so that no one takes your crown.

I will make the one who wins the victory a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will never leave it again. I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from my God. I will also write on him my own new name.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
Write this to the angel of the church in Laodicea: This is what the Amen says, the faithful and true witness, the source of God's creation:
I know what you do. You are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were either cold or hot!
But because you are lukewarm, neither hot nor cold, I am about to spit you out of my mouth.
You say, 'I am rich. I have become wealthy and I do not need anything.' But you do not know that you are miserable, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.

So I advise you to buy from me gold made pure in fire, so that you can be truly rich. Buy white clothes to wear, so that your shameful nakedness is covered. And buy medicine to put on your eyes, so that you can see.
I correct and discipline everyone I love. So be serious, and turn back to God.
Look! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with him, and he with me.
To the one who wins the victory, I will give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat down with my Father on his throne.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."
